mechanism: Both drugs can cause CNS depression and dizziness; isotretinoin's teratogenicity requires strict pregnancy prevention protocols that may be complicated by methocarbamol's sedating effects affecting contraceptive compliance.
action: Counsel patients on additive CNS depression risk; ensure robust contraception compliance monitoring in females of childbearing potential, as methocarbamol-induced sedation may impair adherence to isotretinoin's strict pregnancy prevention program (iPLEDGE).
